1981-2999-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-2999-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

69-539-3172-4644.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-3172-4644.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-3172-4644.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

710-5231-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Danitha.
710-5231-8207.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

512-5475-7203.easyPrerequisites: Brigid and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-5475-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures
512-5475-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Brigid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-5475-7203.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Brigid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

4694-4802-6797-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4802-6797-7306.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

710-2730-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Danitha enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-2730-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4419-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

1315-2693-5478-5721.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
1315-2693-5478-5721.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Zuran Orb repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.
1315-2693-5478-5721.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

851-2757-4573.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

855-2021-2060-7061.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3197-6824-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6824-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

670-1619-3991-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6146.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from exile to the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

112-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
112-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk and return Clockspinning to your hand.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4762-6774.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Loading Zone and Primal Vigor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

628-3967-7212.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

1170-1251-1329-1492.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1251-1329-1492.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2921-3781-4191--122.description:
Cast the Insect from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast the Insect from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Resolve the Zask ability, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1-1786-5636-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1786-5636-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

372-2506-4681.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the nontoken Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to be returned from exile to the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Karmic Guide and the token Abdel Adrian trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling nothing.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put the token Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 2.

3101-3705-4050-5997.manaNeeded: {R}{R}, plus an additional {3} minus {1} for each +1/+1 counter on Runaway Steam-Kin
3101-3705-4050-5997.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa and Runaway Steam-Kin trigger.
Resolve the Iraxxa trigger, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1719-2681-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
1719-2681-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
1719-2681-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2486-5231--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2486-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Repeat.

2835-4191-5010-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

500-851-3858-4751.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power 3 or greater.
500-851-3858-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting sixteen +1/+1 counters on a creature you control with power 3 or greater.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

2440-3887-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Rats.
2440-3887-4050.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
When the Rat enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Rat you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {B}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Rats as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

38-1266-4166-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Goblin Arsonist, adding {R}.
When Goblin Arsonist dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Arsonist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Arsonist trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, and exiling Goblin Arsonist from the top of your library with the ability to play it until your end step.
Cast Goblin Arsonist from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat.

1976-2275-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3575-4875-5150.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature with flying on the battlefield.
Aerie Ouphes does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
"Warrior" chosen with Conspiracy.
3575-4875-5150.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrifcing it, targeting any creature with flying.
When Aerie Ouphes dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with no -1/-1 counter on it due to Bramblewood Paragon and Maskwood Nexus.
Repeat.
Resolve all Aerie Ouphes abilities, destroying the targetted creature(s).

232-732-1506-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
232-732-1506-1636.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

4003-4772-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a Planeswalker spell using Muldrotha this turn.
4003-4772-5131.description:
Cast Mu Yanling from your graveyard by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Mu Yanling enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Mu Yanling's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it.
Mu Yanling dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Mu Yanling ability, tapping all creatures your opponent control and causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

210-2060-4120.description:
Cast Chain Lightning by paying {R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Chain Lightning, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor and choosing to pay {R}{R} to create a copy of Chain Lightning targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1684-2178-4772-5231.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2178-4772-5231.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it to create two Elemental token with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {R}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

864-957-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
864-957-3742.description:
Cast Time Stretch, taking an extra two turns after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness that is tapped and attacking.
Eternal Witness enters, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

884-1824-2925-2932-3260.notablePrerequisites:
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation.
You have at least 3 life.
884-1824-2925-2932-3260.description:
Cast Acererak by paying 2 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, losing each opponent 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Acererak enters the battlefield, triggering Ayara and itself.
Resolve the the Ayara trigger, losing each opponent 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Resolve Acererak trigger, returning it to your hand and venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat.

618-2104-4125.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Shipwreck Dowser triggers, getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser with haste.
The token copy of Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2103-2493-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Archaeomancer.
2103-2493-2665.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2882-4675-4694-5281.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4675-4694-5281.description:
Cast Herbal Poultice by paying {0}.
Herbal Poultice enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Herbal Poultice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
